name: flore
description: 又一个 RSS 阅读器。

scripts.build:desktop:
cd apps/desktop && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('version.go','package main

var version = "'+process.env.npm_package_version+'"
')" && node -e "const {execFileSync,execSync}=require('child_process');const {join}=require('path');const gp=execSync('go env GOPATH',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();execFileSync(join(gp,'bin','wails'+(process.platform==='win32'?'.exe':'')),['build'],{stdio:'inherit'})" && go run ./cmd/package-tool -edition portable -version %npm_package_version% -os windows -arch amd64
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:go && npm run build:desktop
